text:
Which statement refers to convection?
A
It does not involve energy transfer.
B
It is the transfer of heat energy without the movement of particles.
C
It only occurs in liquids or gases.
D
It only occurs in solids.

options.label: A
options.text: It does not involve energy transfer.

options.label: B
options.text: It is the transfer of heat energy without the movement of particles.

options.label: C
options.text: It only occurs in liquids or gases.
